subject: POC trial: success criteria & evaluation plan
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@atlas-payments.com>, Sam Patel <sam.patel@atlas-payments.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-20T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: POC trial: success criteria & evaluation plan

Hi Alex / Sam

Thanks for the call today. Quick recap and proposed success criteria for the 3-week POC we discussed.

Success criteria (proposed):
- Latency: p50 <= 150 ms, p95 <= 350 ms (interactive UI p95 target 250 ms for UX-sensitive endpoints)
- Throughput: sustain 100 req/s at target latency (burst to 300 req/s if needed)
- Cost: average cost/token <= $0.0006 (tracked via token logs per request)
- Quality: human-eval pass rate >= 90% on a 200-item blind eval (majority vote by 3 raters); semantic similarity >= 0.90 on automated evals
- Reliability: 99.9% uptime during test window; error rate <= 0.5%

Ownership:
- Atlas technical owner: Alex Nguyen
- Atlas engineering POC: Sam Patel
- Redwood: Jordan Blake (SE) / Rishi Malhotra (Solutions Eng) / Marissa Cole (Customer Success)

Timeline (3 weeks):
1) Week 1 (integration): model access, networking, dataset ingest, test harness
2) Week 2 (load & quality): throughput tests, stability, blind evals
3) Week 3 (analysis & exec review): finalize metrics, runbacks, exec demo

Attachments I will send: POC_success_criteria.xlsx (spreadsheet with measurement plan) and SOW_AtlasPayments_Draft.pdf (POC SOW). Please confirm dataset delivery mechanism (S3 creds or Drive link) and whether we need an NDA addendum.

Immediate ask: Can you confirm kickoff on Monday 2026-06-22 and that Sam will be the engineering point of contact?

Thanks,

Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@atlas-payments.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Sam Patel <sam.patel@atlas-payments.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-20T18:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC trial: success criteria & evaluation plan

Jordan

Thanks for the recap, this looks aligned with our objectives. A few quick clarifications from our side:
- For the interactive UI flows we care most about, can we tighten the p95 target to 250 ms? That's the threshold our product team wants to hit for checkout flows.
- For quality evaluation we expect a slightly larger blind set (we can do 500 prompts)  we can share a balanced sample from production logs.
- Dataset delivery: we can provide an S3 bucket with temporary credentials; I'll ask Sam to follow up with the details.

Kickoff on Monday 2026-06-22 works for us; Sam will be the engineering POC. Can we do a 30m sync to run through access and the measurement sheet?

Appreciate it  looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Alex Nguyen
Head of ML
Atlas Payments

All

Following up with a concrete evaluation plan and owners so we can move quickly on Monday: 

Evaluation plan (detailed):
- Integration (owner: Sam): provide S3 bucket + temporary creds; share a 500-prompt eval sample (Alex)
- Instrumentation (owner: Rishi): we will ship a lightweight tracer that logs request/response tokens, latency, and model variant mapping; token logs will be stored in the POC bucket (30-day retention by default)
- Load testing (owner: Rishi + Redwood infra): Locust harness to validate sustained 100 req/s and bursts up to 300 req/s; collect p50/p95/p99
- Blind quality eval (owner: Marissa + Atlas): 500-item blind set, 3 internal raters from Atlas + 2 Redwood raters; majority vote determines pass/fail per item
- Cost tracking (owner: Jordan): per-request token accounting with simple dashboard (CSV output)
- Security & privacy (owner: Alex + Jordan): redact PII from logs, confirm retention policy (Atlas requested 30 days) and KMS use for artifacts

Weekly cadence: 30m sync every Wednesday, final demo Friday, week 3 exec summary and decision.

I've attached the POC_success_criteria.xlsx with measurement fields and a draft SOW (SOW_AtlasPayments_Draft.pdf). Please review and comment directly in Drive.

Marissa Cole
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Thanks team  quick clarifications from engineering: 
- On the quality metric: when you say "human-eval pass rate" we interpret that as majority-vote acceptance across 3 raters. That works for us; we'll organize raters on our side.
- On logs/PII: we need a redaction step before logs leave our environment. Atlas policy: retain POC logs for 30 days, encrypted at rest with our KMS. Can Redwood confirm the tracer supports client-side redaction or that we can run the tracer behind our VPC?
- On scheduling: Monday 2026-06-22 10:00am PT 30m kickoff is good. I'll send the S3 bucket name and temporary creds in a separate secure message.

Sam Patel
